tool_calls.arguments: {"layout":"landscape","prompt":"Create a high-resolution, clean editorial-style photographic image in landscape orientation: a modern office rooftop at sunrise with multiple rows of sleek photovoltaic solar panels. Composition should be wide, cinematic, with leading lines from the panels guiding the eye toward a warm, golden sunrise on the horizon. Include a contemporary office building facade in the midground with glass and metal elements, and a soft, distant urban skyline silhouette in the background. Lighting: golden hour sunrise, warm directional sunlight, gentle long shadows, subtle lens flare, natural reflections on glass and panel surfaces. Atmosphere: crisp, minimal, optimistic. Color palette: warm golds and cool blues, high dynamic range, natural contrast. Keep camera perspective slightly elevated and angled to show both panel surfaces and rooftop plane. No people, no text, no logos, no visible brand markings, no watermarks, and no additional graphic overlays. Photographic details: shallow-to-moderate depth of field, sharp focus on foreground panels, slight atmospheric haze toward horizon, realistic textures on panels and rooftop materials. Deliver as a clean editorial photograph suitable for a corporate sustainability report."}
tool_calls.name: image_generate
